name: @stapel/categories-react
description: Headless React pair for stapel-categories: a typed client, a client-assembled category tree, and the revision-delta sync the module documents. The list endpoint returns FLAT rows with treenode ancestry as comma-joined pk strings — this package parses them, builds the tree, resolves a slug to a category (the server has no slug lookup), walks breadcrumbs, and keeps the whole catalogue in an app-scoped repository refreshed by `?min_revision=` deltas instead of refetching it on every page. Category and feature names are TRANSLATION KEYS on the wire, never resolved labels, and the pair says so in its types. A category's feature schema is served typed for @stapel/attributes-react to draw and for search facets to label. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.

size-limit.name: index — the headless pair (client + tree assembly + delta sync + hooks): no antd. 9 -> 9.5 KB for the browse-stage wave: the nested tree read (useCategoryTree + its key), browseStage, and categoryIconSrc. Three small pure additions the storefront needs on every catalogue page, 31 B over the old line - raised deliberately, not silently. 9.5 -> 9.75 KB for the effective-features wave: the `X-Effective-From` raw-fetch carve-out (`api/featuresRaw.ts`, the ONE legal home of `fetch` for a header `StapelClient.get` cannot see), `visibleFeatures`, and the cascade's `partitionChild` pass-through — 70 B over the old line, and every byte of it is either the one request `client.get` cannot make or a pure filter a composer and a facet rail both need. 9.75 -> 9.9 KB for the transparent-wrapper rule (`catalog/wrapper.ts`'s `isTransparentWrapper`/`browseChildren`, plus the cascade's own one-rung merge): a one-child import level the census found under a real root, skipped without a second copy of `hasChildren`'s fallback chain. 9.9 -> 9.95 KB for `isWrapperAncestor`: the same wrapper rule asked of a breadcrumb trail's own rows (`tn_children_pks`'s count standing in for the full sibling array a tile page has and a crumb list does not) — 20 B over the old line, no second fetch.

default — the antd skin (catalog, category page, carousel, picker, breadcrumbs) must stay out of the main bundle. 13.25 -> 13.5 KB when the compact-tile anatomy landed (density prop, centred icon-over-label variant, its own measure hook): the skin crossed the old line by 3 bytes, and a budget that fails on 3 B of a shipped feature is a gate proving nothing - raised deliberately, not silently. 13.5 -> 15.25 KB when the desktop mega-menu landed: a root rail with a roving-tabindex menu model, a pane of second-level columns with a capped third level, the outside-click and Escape wiring and the minWidth guard - one panel, 1.44 KB, and no part of it is carried by a host that imports only the headless entry. 15.25 -> 15.5 KB for the storefront's three slots: the tile grid's wrapping layout (minTileWidth, the auto-fill track), its icon-address resolver, and the category page's heading slot - 19 B over the old line, and every byte of it is a host drawing its own copy of this skin that it no longer has to. 15.5 -> 15.75 KB for the mega-menu's onSelect (a rail root, a column header and a third-level link each report which node was pressed, with the `stapel/clickable-needs-event` opt-out beside them) and the category page's own `measure` prop — 70 B over the old line, replacing a host's `!important` override with a value it can read back. 15.75 -> 16 KB for the tiles arm's own wrapper skip (`TileSubcategories`, one small `useCategoryChildren` read gated on the single-child case) — the storefront's `/c/uslugi` no longer draws one tile for an import level nobody may act on. 16 -> 16.1 KB for a transparent wrapper's own breadcrumb crumb: `linked: false` renders it as plain text instead of a link, decided by `isWrapperAncestor` or a host `unlink` predicate — 81 B over the old line for a defect the storefront integrator named by hand.
